annexes.title: PSA Certificate of Death of Vicente Inocalla, Sr. (died 26 November 1984)
annexes.note: Referred to in paragraph 2 of the petition. Proves the death and the residence at death that fixes venue under Section 1, Rule 73.
annexes.missing: Not yet in hand. To be ordered from the Philippine Statistics Authority (README pathway, step 2) and inserted here before filing.

annexes.title: PSA Certificate of Death of Beatriz Villafria Inocalla (died 12 August 1985)
annexes.note: Referred to in paragraph 2 of the petition.
annexes.missing: Not yet in hand. To be ordered from the Philippine Statistics Authority (README pathway, step 2) and inserted here before filing.

annexes.title: Schedule of Heirs, Creditors and Other Interested Persons for Notice (Section 2, Rule 79), with the certificates of death of the deceased children
annexes.note: Referred to in paragraphs 4, 5 and 8-B and prayer (b). One row per heir with name, age and residence, across the ten branches; the known creditors (Bureau of Internal Revenue; the local governments for real property tax); and the two persons named in paragraph 5. The schedule itself is to be prepared by the petitioner with the family from the heir roster (README pathway, step 4) and inserted before the certificates.
files_desc: Attached: Certificate of Death of Vicente Villafria Inocalla, Jr., Local Civil Registry of Jose Panganiban, Registry No. 2017-191 (certified true machine copy), died 11 September 2017, 12:05 p.m., Purok 5, Sta. Rosa Sur; cause: neurogenic shock, multiple gunshot wound. PSA copy, and the PSA certificates of death of Senen, Francisco, Cipriana, Casper and Melvyn, to be obtained and inserted after it.

annexes.title: Certified true copy of TCT No. (44055) 002-2026001670, Registry of Deeds of Manila, restored to Beatriz V. Inocalla married to Vicente Inocalla on 16 April 2026; with the judgment, finality and execution records of Civil Case No. 13-131220, RTC Manila, Branch 15
annexes.note: Referred to in paragraphs 6(b), 7 and 11 and in the affidavit, paragraph 2.
files_desc: Attached: the Registry's electronic certified true copy, 5 pages, requested by Allan Inocalla on 5 August 2026 (OR No. 1040475498). Entry No. 2026004663 of 16 April 2026 on its memorandum of encumbrances recites the dispositive portion of the Decision of 15 February 2019 and the Certificate of Finality of 23 January 2020. No separate copy of the judgment is attached (rev. 12-B); the certified Decision, Certificate of Finality and alias writ remain in the petitioner's file for the hearing.

annexes.title: Compromise Agreement of 24 January 1992 in Civil Case No. B-5625 (also cited as 5626), RTC Camarines Norte, Branch 41, Daet, for judicial partition; with the Order of 28 January 1992 approving it and the Certificate of Finality of 26 March 2014
annexes.note: Referred to in paragraphs 3 and 6 and in Annex G.
files_desc: Attached: the Compromise Agreement as filed, 6 pages, bearing the Branch 41 receiving stamp and the exhibit markings. The certified copies of the approving Order and of the Certificate of Finality are to be obtained from the Office of the Clerk of Court, RTC Branch 41, Daet (README pathway, step 5) and inserted after the agreement.

annexes.title: PSA Certificate of Live Birth of Allan V. Inocalla
annexes.note: Referred to in paragraph 11 and in the affidavit, paragraph 1. Proves filiation to the decedents and the petitioner's standing as next of kin under Section 6, Rule 78.
annexes.missing: Not yet in hand. To be ordered from the Philippine Statistics Authority (README pathway, step 3) and inserted here before filing.

annexes.title: Special powers of attorney in favor of the petitioner
annexes.note: Referred to in paragraph 11 and in the affidavit, paragraph 4.
files_desc: Attached: the heirs' special power of attorney acknowledged before the Philippine Embassy, Brasilia, on 10 July 2024, 4 pages, signed by Herbert, Jesus and Marilou Inocalla and Cipriana Inocalla Cambronero among others. The special power of attorney of Jesus V. Inocalla (Daet, August 2025, Doc. No. 518, Atty. Sherwin O. Mata) and of Marilou V. Inocalla (Paranaque City, 5 August 2025, Doc. No. 56, Page 24) are in the petitioner's file and follow this document when the binder is assembled for filing.

annexes.title: Schedule of Subject Properties (bound with the petition), with the tax declarations of the City of Manila and the Paracale assessor's record
annexes.note: Referred to in paragraph 6 and prayer (a)(i). The values pleaded in paragraph 6: Manila land ARP AD-14759-00324 (market PhP 3,024,000; assessed PhP 1,209,600), Manila building ARP AD-14759-00219 (market PhP 1,008,000; assessed PhP 352,800), Paracale assessor's roll for the 13.3690-hectare parcel (market value in excess of PhP 744,000).
annexes.missing: The schedule is printed with the petition after the annex list. Certified current copies of the Manila tax declarations (land and building) and the Paracale tax declaration for TCT No. T-2194 are to be obtained (README pathway, step 5) and inserted here; the copies on file are 2014/2016 certified copies and a photographed assessor's listing.

annexes.title: Certified true copy of TCT No. T-2194, Registry of Deeds of Camarines Norte, in the name of Vicente Inocalla, married to Beatriz Villafria (Barrio Batobalani, Paracale, 13.3690 hectares)
annexes.note: Referred to in paragraphs 6(a) and 8, in the affidavit, paragraph 3, and in Annex G. Issued 11 July 2024 on the request of Allan Inocalla (Ref. No. 2024003960, OR No. 1031911034).
files_desc: Attached: pages 1 to 4 of the 5-page certified copy (the title page and the memorandum of encumbrances through the entry of 21 February 1994). Page 5 of 5, the additional sheet, is held by the petitioner on paper and is to be inserted after page 4.

annexes.title: Affidavit of Allan V. Inocalla in support of the petition (bound with the petition), with the records of Barangay 759, Zone 82, Santa Ana, City of Manila, in Barangay Case No. 001
annexes.note: Referred to in paragraphs 7 to 9 and 10-E and prayer (a)(iii).
files_desc: Attached first: the Summons of the Office of the Lupong Tagapamayapa in Barangay Case No. 001 (for ejectment), Jesus V. Inocalla et al. v. Vicente de Leon Inocalla III and Elena de Leon Inocalla, setting the mediation for 23 January 2026, and the Certification to File Action, 2 pages. The blotter entry of 22 August 2025 and the complaint of 28 August 2025 are in the petitioner's file and follow these when the binder is assembled for filing.
The 2014 levy papers, the tenancy-case records and the NBI records are held out of this binder (revs. 12 and 12-B) and remain on file for the hearing on letters.

annexes.title: Proposed Order (bound with the petition after Annex G)
annexes.note: Referred to in paragraph 10-E. A one-page order appointing the petitioner special administrator under Section 1, Rule 80 pending letters, with the powers in prayer (a), the Section 2, Rule 80 limits, the Section 3, Rule 80 sunset, and the setting and publication of the hearing on letters. The bond amount and the hearing date are left for the Court.
annexes.missing: The proposed Order is printed at the end of the petition, immediately after Annex G. No separate document is inserted here.
